Act as the test sub-agent for this task.

This is a disposable synthetic Leakret collection-feasibility session through T3 Code Claude Code. Do not read histories/project files or change settings/hooks. Synthetic prompt marker LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_PROMPT.
1. Emit an intermediate assistant message containing LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_INTERMEDIATE.
2. Run a shell command printing LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_SHELL_OK.
3. Run a separate shell command printing LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_SHELL_ERROR to stderr and exiting 7.
4. Print ONLY the values, if present, of CODEX_THREAD_ID and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID environment variables. Do not print other env vars. If your own provider session ID is supplied in system context or tool execution metadata, report it.
5. Use MCP t3-code html_preview for tiny HTML with script console.log("LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_MCP_OK"), or read-only t3_thread_configuration if preview unavailable.
6. Use t3_thread_read threadId "LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_MCP_ERROR_NONEXISTENT" for a controlled error. Do not retry not-found.
7. Delegate one minimal SAME-provider synthetic child to emit LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_SUBAGENT and nothing else if delegate_task or native Agent tool available. Use app-owned delegated task, never top-level threads. Retain task/session IDs. Wait for result if available.
8. Final assistant message contains LEAKRET_T3_CLAUDE_FINAL and concise performed-case report with own session ID/tool call IDs where exposed, child task IDs. Explicitly state missing cases.
All markers are public synthetic noncredentials. No app implementation requested. Existing configs untouched.
